name: Fitness or yoga studio
description: Energetic site for a studio or gym: classes, membership pricing, timetable questions and a map.

content.heading: Classes that fit a working week
content.subheading: Early mornings and late evenings, in small groups, for people who sit at a desk all day.

content.heading: What we run
content.feature1Text: Barbell basics in groups of six, coached every session.
content.feature2Text: Unhurried classes aimed at stiff hips and tired shoulders.
content.feature3Text: Forty minutes, no equipment to learn, finished before work.

content.heading: Nobody starts fit
content.body: Most people arrive having done nothing for years, and that is the normal case here rather than the exception. Every movement has an easier version, and the coach will give it to you before you have to ask.

content.heading: Membership
content.plan1Feature2: Book up to a week ahead

content.heading: Members
content.quote1: First gym where nobody made me feel like an idiot on day one.
content.quote2: My back has stopped hurting at work. That is the whole review.
content.quote3: The 6am class means it is done before the day starts.

content.heading: First class is free
content.subheading: Turn up in whatever you own. We have mats, water and somewhere to change.

content.heading: Timetable
content.subheading: When everything runs, and how booking works.

content.heading: Booking and classes
content.q1: How far ahead can I book?
content.a1: Seven days for members, two days on pay-as-you-go.
content.q2: What if I have to cancel?
content.a2: Cancel more than four hours before and the class goes back into your allowance.
content.q3: Do I need my own equipment?
content.a3: No. Mats, bands and everything else are here. Bring a towel and water.
content.a4: Two showers and lockers. Bring a padlock or borrow one at reception.

content.heading: Contact
content.subheading: Where we are and how to reach us.

content.heading: Find the studio
content.hours: Mon to Fri 5am to 9pm, Sat and Sun 7am to 2pm
